business.name: Social 114
business.tagline: Coffee and brunch by day. Wood-fired pizza and wine by night.

instagram._source: Linked by La Vida Liverpool, Oct 2022. Confirm still current.

facebook._source: Linked by La Vida Liverpool, Oct 2022. Confirm still current.

day.label: Day
day.headline: Coffee, brunch and a slow morning on Victoria Road.
day.body: Good coffee, matcha, loose leaf tea, bakes and brunch on sourdough. A bright room with a chilled playlist, and dogs welcome.

night.label: Night
night.headline: The oven's lit. Pizza, wine and records.
night.body: Neapolitan-style pizza from the wood-fired oven, wines picked by a sommelier, good beer and the odd vinyl night.

hours._source: La Vida Liverpool (Oct 2022) and listings. Confirm current hours.

menu._source: Dishes named in La Vida Liverpool (2022), Wanderlog reviews and a third-party menu page. Prices deliberately left off until confirmed.
menu.note: A short menu that changes. Ask what's on today.

pizza.label: Pizza
pizza.intro: Neapolitan style. Light, thin bases, straight from the wood-fired oven.

items.name: Sweet potato and stilton
items.desc: Soft, sharp and a bit rich.

items.name: Bakes
items.desc: Cakes and pastries on the counter

oven.headline: After brunch, the fire goes in.
oven.body: The kitchen switches over in the afternoon: the wood-fired oven comes up to heat and the evening menu starts. Neapolitan pizza cooks fast in a hot oven, so the bases stay light and blistered.

nights.headline: Records on, lights down.
nights.body: Vinyl DJ sets and community evenings in the Victoria Quarter. Dates go up on Instagram first.

street.headline: In the middle of the Victoria Quarter.
street.body: Victoria Road is New Brighton's street art quarter, and Social 114 sits right in it. Co-owner Robert Jones coordinates the street art on the road; his partner Vic runs the hospitality side.
street.directions: A short walk down Victoria Road from New Brighton station, towards the prom.
